feature_name: Proxy-based CalendarServiceMap Mock for Test Stability
description: Create a Proxy-based mock implementation for the CalendarServiceMap to prevent flaky test failures in CI. The mock should intercept all calendar service module imports and prevent real implementations from triggering async operations that can cause Vitest worker shutdown errors. This should replace the current hardcoded mock that only handles specific calendar services.
functional_requirements: Implement a Proxy handler that intercepts all property access on the CalendarServiceMap mock
Ensure the mock prevents real calendar service modules (feishu, lark, etc.) from importing and executing their initialization code
Create a shared mock factory that can be used both in vi.mock() calls and in test setup functions
Make the mock compatible with existing test infrastructure that expects specific calendar service keys to be available
Ensure the solution handles transitive imports that trigger module-resolution RPC calls during test teardown
Maintain backward compatibility with existing tests that rely on calendar service mocking
